_doc: DERIVED from savannah-2313.png through tools/savannah-2313-extract.py, using the registration in savannah-2313-georef.json. Who holds the ground: the state core, its two occupied territories, the dissident settlements free and occupied, and the three tribal areas. `entityType` carries what each one IS and must not be flattened to 'faction'.
eraNote: EVERY feature is dated 2313. Misfits' present is about 2302, so this sheet is ELEVEN YEARS AHEAD of it. Owner's ruling: use it as-is to describe the south-east in more detail, mutating where it disagrees - not as a dated observation to be projected.
publication: REPOSITORY MATERIAL ONLY. The sheet carries no printed licence, so nothing derived from it is published until the owner rules. A creator name is not a licence.

boundaryExclusion.where: Louisiana marsh and Mississippi delta, lon -91.0 to -88.8, lat 28.9 to 30.5
boundaryExclusion.why: Holds 207 of the 214 points worse than 15 km and every point worse than 20 km, including the 33.8 km worst case. Both directions fail here at once -- the sheet draws land where there is water and omits Lake Pontchartrain, Lake Borgne, Mississippi Sound and the delta birdfoot -- which is the signature of a simplified trace, not a registration error.

properties.name: North Carolina Territory
properties.entityNote: Ground the state has taken and holds under occupation, drawn in a lighter shade than its core spheres. Not an internal division.

properties.entityNote: Ground the state has taken and holds under occupation, drawn in a lighter shade than its core spheres. Not an internal division.

properties.name: Organized Dissident Settlements
properties.entityNote: NOT A POLITY. 'Dissidents' is the label the state applies to anyone who resisted it, who could be imprisoned, enslaved or killed without trial. This belt is those refugees, driven out by the state's expansion, settled along a major river and now raiding back.

extraction.survivalNote: Percent of colour-matched pixels surviving an opening of radius 3. Every fill on this sheet survives 99%+; the ink survives 9.8%, because it is line work and lettering. A fill channel far below 90% is matching the boundary network rather than territory.
